project_type: Single-file Google Colab Python script that faithfully re-executes an original ComfyUI LTX-2.3 Director 2.0 MV workflow graph. No package/module structure; the deliverable is one .py file with `# ===== CELL N =====` delimiters meant to be pasted into Colab cells.
language: Python (3.9 available in this sandbox; the deliverable targets Colab's Python 3.10/3.11 T4 runtime). Use `python3`.
build_system: None. No build tooling. Validation is `python3 -m py_compile <file>` plus a standalone `--validate-only` smoke test that runs the JSON parser + graph validator against the real JSON without torch/CUDA/ComfyUI.
test_framework: No existing test framework. The deliverable itself must expose a CPU-only, dependency-light smoke path (parser + validator) invokable via `python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` and/or an `if __name__ == '__main__'` guard.
test_command: python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only  (loads LTX-2.3_Director_2.0-MV-Workflow-30s.json, runs graph parser + validator, prints all-PASS report; must NOT require torch/CUDA/ComfyUI)
verification_instructions: 1) `python3 -m py_compile LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py` returns exit 0. 2) `python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` loads the real JSON, parses 32 nodes/65 links/4 groups, runs the graph validator, and prints the Section-27 validation report with every line PASS. 3) The Section-41 self-audit checklist is printed with all items checked. GPU execution (model download, ComfyUI node execution, CUDA, final MP4) CANNOT be verified in this sandbox (no GPU/ComfyUI/multi-GB models) and must be reported as 'requires real Colab T4 run'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked into the repo. The final MP4 is produced only on real Colab hardware and is not a repo artifact.
setup_instructions: No host setup needed for the validate-only smoke test beyond stdlib (json, argparse). GPU-only imports (torch, comfy, psutil, safetensors, ctypes.libc calls) MUST be guarded/lazy so the parser+validator run with stdlib alone. On real Colab the script installs ComfyUI + custom nodes + downloads models in CELLS 3-7.
environment_constraints: Sandbox network mode: OPEN_INTERNET (reference lookups possible). BUT no NVIDIA GPU, no ComfyUI, no CUDA, multi-GB LTX models cannot be downloaded/run here. Therefore end-to-end execution is IMPOSSIBLE in-sandbox. Only pure-Python layers (JSON parse, graph parse, graph validator, timeline parsing, memory-stat formatting that degrades gracefully without torch/cuda) are testable here. Do NOT claim 'guaranteed no crash' (user Section 40).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Git: work on a NEW feature branch `feat/original-graph-faithful-colab-pipeline` (base `main`, commit e5727b8). Do NOT commit to main. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that).
key_patterns: The reference JSON LTX-2.3_Director_2.0-MV-Workflow-30s.json is the SOURCE OF TRUTH. Architecture MUST be: load JSON -> parse into internal graph (nodes/links/widgets_values) -> topologically execute the REAL registered ComfyUI node classes via a memory-aware execute_node()/call_comfy_node() -> original output. LTXDirector (node id 131) stays the master timeline controller. FORBIDDEN: reproducing V2/V3's 5-segment scene loop, linear_blend_overlap(), per-scene EmptyLTXVLatentVideo/audio latents, post-only FFmpeg audio mux, silent try/except fallbacks. Memory infra (CELL 7 of V2, lines 480-699) is lifted as INFRASTRUCTURE only: malloc_trim via ctypes libc, psutil.virtual_memory().available, torch.cuda.mem_get_info, gc.collect, empty_cache/ipc_collect, comfy unload_all_models/cleanup_models/soft_empty_cache, POSIX fadvise page-cache drop, memory_guard/deep_memory_cleanup, 2.0GB RAM / 1.2GB VRAM thresholds. V3 (LTX23_Director_Master_V3_Production.py) supplies known-good HuggingFace download URLs (lines ~205-250) and custom-node repo URLs (lines ~137-143) but its 5-segment ARCHITECTURE is FORBIDDEN.
